title: Hard at Work
description: Builders work on construction of the South-North Water Transfer Project in the Shandong Province in China. Launched in 2002 with completion expected in 2050, the project's goal is to move trillions of gallons of water each year from the Yangtze River Basin in the south to the Yellow River Basin in the north.
translated_description: 建筑工人在中国山东省南水北调工程施工现场工作。该工程于2002年启动，预计2050年完工，目标是将每年数万亿加仑的水从南方的长江流域调往北方的黄河流域。
